row: Welcome to my channel, everyone! I am currently a final year veterinary science student at Onderstepoort Veterinary University (OP) in South Africa. I started this channel so that I can show my journey as a veterinary science student and, hopefully one day, as a vet, by sharing my experiences with you. I would like to stress that these are only my experiences and, obviously, each student will experience this course in their own way, so let me know about your thoughts and experiences in the comments! To all the vets and future vets of the country, thank you for all your hard work and never give up. What you do for both people and animals is incredible. You are really making this world a better place. I hope you enjoy my channel and that it can help you on your journey.
